0x100DC1F0.name: TimeTrack_Reset

0x100DC210.name: TimeTrack_Update

0x100DC210.summary: Updates the last tick count and counts timer wraparounds.

0x100DC250.name: TimeTrack_GetWrapCount
0x100DC250.evidence: returns the dword at g+0x4C, which TimeTrack_Update increments
0x100DC250.summary: Returns the number of timer wraparounds counted.

0x100DC260.name: TimeTrack_GetLastTick
0x100DC260.evidence: returns the dword at g+0x50, which TimeTrack_Reset and TimeTrack_Update store
0x100DC260.summary: Returns the last recorded tick count.

0x100DC270.name: Crypt_InitContext

0x100DC270.summary: Sets up the crypt context in the global buffer.

0x100DC2C0.name: Crypt_IsInitialized
0x100DC2C0.evidence: returns 1 iff the global DAT_104AE8AC is non-null
0x100DC2C0.summary: Tests whether the crypt context has been set up.

0x100DCA00.name: Crypt_EncryptBlocks
0x100DCA00.evidence: processes 8-byte blocks in the forward order, XORing each with the 0x12-entry key schedule at param_1[0..0x11] and two 0x100-entry S-box tables
0x100DCA00.summary: Runs the block cipher forward over a buffer of 8-byte blocks.

0x100DCF60.name: Crypt_DecryptBlocks
0x100DCF60.evidence: same block structure as Crypt_EncryptBlocks, but the key schedule is applied from param_1[0x11] down to param_1[0]
0x100DCF60.summary: Runs the block cipher in reverse over a buffer of 8-byte blocks.

0x100DD590.name: Packet_EncodeMd5
0x100DD590.evidence: initialises an MD5 context (fn_100DDE90, sub_100DDEC0, sub_100DDF60), copies the 0x1C-byte header, and encrypts the body with fn_100DF7C0 and fn_100DCA00

0x100DD6C0.evidence: checks the packet length against 0x2D..0x550, recomputes the MD5 digest with fn_100DDE90, sub_100DDEC0 and sub_100DDF60, compares it with the stored one, then decodes the body with fn_100DF5D0
0x100DD6C0.summary: Checks and decodes a packet that carries an MD5 digest.

0x100DD800.name: MD5_HashPair
0x100DD800.evidence: initialises an MD5 state (fn_100DDE90), updates it with two buffers (sub_100DDEC0 twice), finalises (sub_100DDF60) and writes the 16-byte digest to the output
0x100DD800.summary: Computes the MD5 digest of two buffers in sequence.

0x100DD920.name: Random_Next
0x100DD920.summary: Returns the next value from the C runtime random generator.

0x100DDE90.name: MD5_Init
0x100DDE90.evidence: sets the count to 0 and the state to 0x67452301, 0xEFCDAB89, 0x98BADCFE, 0x10325476, the MD5 initial values

0x100DE010.evidence: 64-step MD5 block transform: round constants 0xD76AA478 (as -0x28955B88), 0xE8C7B756 and so on, with the standard rotate amounts

0x100DF5D0.name: BitTree_Decode
0x100DF5D0.evidence: walks a binary tree of two-child nodes using the input bits (node at +0 for 0, +4 for 1) and writes the leaf symbol byte, returning the count written

0x100DF6E0.name: BitTree_CopyBits
0x100DF6E0.evidence: copies bits one at a time from a source bit array into a destination bit array at the given bit offsets, with bounds checks

0x100DF7C0.name: BitTree_Encode
0x100DF7C0.evidence: calls fn_100DF6E0 to write bits for the input, and returns the bit count rounded to bytes

0x100E08D0.name: Entry_FindByNormalizedName

0x100E13C0.name: Entry_ResetFields

0x100E1790.evidence: computes an MD5 over the 0x14 bytes at param_1+0x7A3 (fn_100DDE90, sub_100DDEC0, sub_100DDF60), stores the digest and the arguments, then calls fn_100D8A20

0x100E19C0.name: Table_AllocEntry4

0x100E1B50.evidence: counts the non-zero dwords at the two entries of the list at +0x1F20 (0x1F5-dword stride) of the object at DAT_104DF770+0x1369C
